text:
Yes, there are several. What fits depends on your Model Y's model year.

**2020 to early-2025 Model Y: plug-in rear display (works while driving)**
- **TESERY 8.66" Android display, $359** (fits 2020 to 2025.03). It supports CarPlay and rear climate and seat heat controls, and it's a DIY install with instructions: https://www.tesery.com/products/tesery-8-66-inch-rear-entertainment-display-screen-for-tesla
- **Teslahubs Rear Display Ultra, $269.99** (2019 to 2024), the cheapest of the group according to Dealectric's comparison. I don't have a direct product link for it, only the comparison page: https://dealectric.com/tesla-model-y-back-seat-screen
- **Amazon options** run about $304 to $330 for 8.66" units that fit 2019 to 2024 cars: https://www.amazon.com/tesla-model-y-rear-screen/s?k=tesla+model+y+rear+screen. The top listings have few reviews (one is 3.6 stars from 10 ratings), so I'd lean toward TESERY, which is 4.7 stars from 22 reviews on its own site.

Check the year range before you buy. These displays were made for the older console and won't fit the 2025 refresh.

**2025 to 2026 refreshed Model Y ("Juniper")**
- Most trims already have Tesla's own 8" rear touchscreen, so you may not need to buy anything.
- **Standard trim with no rear screen:** Hansshow's H86 is $399.99, per Dealectric's comparison (no direct link in my results).
- **For parked movies or camping:** the **Aurzen TravelPlay AutoCinema Screen, $119.99**, clips into the roof or rear window and doubles as a sunshade. It needs a separate projector, and Aurzen says not to use it while driving: https://aurzen.com/products/aurzen-travelplay-autocinema-screen-for-tesla-model-y
- **Cheapest option on any year:** a seat-back tablet mount. TESERY's is $19.99, but it doesn't fit the Juniper Performance or Standard trims. I don't have a direct link for it.

**My pick**
- **Kids on road trips, 2020 to early-2025 car:** the TESERY 8.66" at $359, or Teslahubs if you want to spend less.
- **2025 or newer:** try the built-in screen first, then add a $19.99 tablet mount if you want something bigger.
- **Parked movie nights:** the Aurzen screen plus a projector.

Some links on the Dealectric comparison page are affiliate links. I've linked directly to the brands' own pages where I could. What model year is your Model Y? I can narrow it down to one pick.
